declarations.name: AuiFileManager

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the File Manager region, such as 'Company documents'.

inputs.name: provider
inputs.description: Async storage: list, createFolder, rename, move, delete, upload, and optional getUrl and read; every call receives an AbortSignal.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: The top folder { id, label }; changing it lists the new root.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: No create, rename, move, delete, or upload.

inputs.name: accept
inputs.description: Accepted uploads: MIME types (image/*) and extensions (.csv).

inputs.name: preview
inputs.description: Preview of opened files: auto (images in an Image Viewer lightbox, text and code in a Code Viewer dialog), false, or a function returning a Node.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Block size as a CSS length, or null to fill the host.

inputs.name: view
inputs.description: List rows with columns, or tiles.

inputs.name: foldersFirst
inputs.description: Folders before files, whatever the sort.

inputs.name: showFolderPane
inputs.description: Show the folder tree next to the content.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of sizes, dates, sorting, and messages.

outputs.name: navigate
outputs.description: Another folder is shown: { folderId, path }.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user changed the selection: { selected }.

outputs.name: opened
outputs.description: A file was opened (Enter or double click): { entry }; preventDefault() suppresses the built-in preview.

outputs.name: renamed
outputs.description: An entry was renamed: { entry, previousName }.

outputs.name: moved
outputs.description: Entries were moved: { entries, targetFolderId, source: 'drag' | 'paste' }.

outputs.name: uploaded
outputs.description: One file finished uploading: { entry, file }.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: A provider call failed: { operation, error, entries }.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Select entries of the current folder (no event).

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Upload files to the current folder (checked against accept and maxFileSize).

accessibility.pattern: A labelled region with a WAI-ARIA APG toolbar, a Breadcrumb navigation, a Tree View of folders, and the folder content as an APG listbox with multiple selection (focus stays on the listbox; aria-activedescendant names the active entry). Dialogs follow the APG dialog and alertdialog patterns.

limitations: No copy operation: the provider contract covers move, rename, delete, create, and upload.
Folder uploads (directories dropped from the operating system) are not expanded; only files are uploaded.
Paths of folders opened through navigate() are known only for folders the File Manager has listed before.
